status: post-hoc, exploratory (all labels released; not pre-registered beyond PREREG_LEX_front.md; the E8b arms follow PREREG_E8b_lex_llm.md)

definitions.accuracy: C48: bank-estimated delivered accuracy p (tie-averaged) on the no-diagnostic bank; T200: realized S_known (passk)
definitions.consistency: C48: p^2 + (1-p)^2 from the bank p (E8b arms: from the mean p over their 5 decisions); T200: not measurable per item (one realization)
definitions.latency: chosen option's parallel wall-clock (C48: bank expected max of n call latencies; T200: slowest member of the realized pool) + selector overhead

overhead.diag: max of the item's five diagnostic call latencies
overhead.llm: A0: the E8a decision latency summed over every attempt; B0: per decision, latency_s summed over its attempts, averaged over the item's 5 decisions

definitions.c48_bank: no-diagnostic bank (the five diagnostic draws, legacy A slots 20-24, are removed from every item's A-level bank because P1-P3, the heuristic and A1/B1 read them); the full bank's numbers are kept under c48_bank_sensitivity
definitions.e8b: LLM:B0/B1 = PREREG_E8b: told the LEX objective, M15 menu with typical times, 5 independent decisions per item (option order reshuffled); invalid after one retry -> 1x16. Per item: accuracy = mean over decisions of the option's accuracy; C48 consistency = p_sys^2 + (1-p_sys)^2 of that mean; latency = mean over decisions of (option latency + call latency summed over attempts [+ diagnostics wall-clock for B1]). choice = modal option; stability = share of the modal option among the item's decisions
definitions.stat_rule: LEX rule per item on predicted p_delivered, C = p^2+(1-p)^2 of the prediction, latency = C48 front-bank latency mean per (shard, option) (leave-item-out on C48)
definitions.heuristic_rule: if the plurality share f1 of the five diagnostic answers >= tau then X else 1x16; (tau, X) in {0.6, 0.8, 1.0} x menu chosen on the training items by macro accuracy (C48 items: no-diagnostic bank p; other L96 items: realized S_known) -> macro consistency (bank items only) -> macro latency incl. diagnostics -> fewer tokens -> larger tau
definitions.population_rank: repeated LEX selection over deployable selectors (fixed M15, stat, heuristic, LLM A0/A1/B0/B1): macro accuracy within 0.02 of the best -> consistency within 0.02 (C48 only) -> lowest macro latency
definitions.winner_share: share of 10,000 benchmark-stratified bootstrap replicates in which the selector is the population LEX winner among the deployable selectors (C48: macro; T200: winner_share_macro and winner_share_mixture)
definitions.stat_minus_llm: every statistical/heuristic row minus A0 and A1 (E8a, M5 menu); rows on the M15 menu also minus B0 and B1 (E8b's menu)
definitions.llm_objective_effect: LLM:B minus LLM:A (told the objective, M15 menu, 5 decisions vs asked for accuracy only, M5 menu, 1 decision) and B1 minus B0
definitions.headline: per view (C48 macro, T200 macro, T200 mixture): in_top_band = accuracy within delta of the best deployable row; within_delta_of_1x16 = accuracy at most delta below always-1x16; ci_side = +1/-1 if the 95% percentile CI lies above/below 0, else 0 (a bound within 1e-9 of 0 counts as touching); like-for-like statistical rows = the LLM's own menu (A0/A1: C48 stat M5, T200 sealed M5; B0/B1: stat M15 on both panels)

c48_bank.nodiag: lexfront.estimate() on the C48 bank minus the five diagnostic draws per item (legacy_main A slots 20-24) -> lex/selcmp/front_estimates_nodiag.parquet; only A-level options (n x 1) change
c48_bank.full: lex/front_estimates.parquet (the LEX front bank, diagnostics included): sensitivity only
c48_bank.class_labels: the full-bank item classes (as lexfront's split-half check); rebuilding the classes on the reduced bank gives the identical partition on 48 of 48 items
c48_bank.selector_inputs_unchanged: the statistical rule's predicted-latency table (C48 bank latency per (shard, option), leave-item-out) stays on the front estimates, like the typical times in the E8b prompt; outcomes (scoring, oracles, split-half, the heuristic's C48 training outcomes) use the scoring bank; the split-half reference is re-chosen and re-scored on the no-diagnostic halves (lex/selcmp/front_splithalf_nodiag.parquet)

crossfit.outer_folds: glm.grouped_folds(L96, 5, seed 20260925) = the E5 ridge-CV fold assignment on L96 (verified identical to the sealed fit's)

c48_bank_sensitivity.note: C48 scored on the full LEX-front bank (the five diagnostic draws included), everything else equal; the heuristic is also trained on that bank's C48 outcomes. Without LLM:B0/B1 these rows reproduce the previous selcmp report.
